application_status.label: Annual cap of 200 visas
application_status.detail: The Embassy states that Working Holiday issuance for Finnish citizens is limited to 200 per year and applications close when that number is reached. Recheck availability before applying.

change_control.review_note: Finland ruleset verified against the current Embassy Working Holiday page and July 2026 visa application procedure.

summary_facts.label: Participation
summary_facts.value: One Working Holiday visa, except narrowly defined unused-visa reissue cases

summary_facts.label: Funds baseline
summary_facts.value: More than €4,200 in the applicant's name

eligibility_rules.fail_message: This Working Holiday route is for Finnish citizens.

eligibility_rules.fail_message: Finnish Working Holiday applicants must be resident in Finland.

eligibility_rules.fail_message: The Finnish Working Holiday age range is 18–30 inclusive at application.

eligibility_rules.fail_message: The Finnish programme is for a holiday in Japan; employment is incidental.

eligibility_rules.fail_message: The Working Holiday conditions do not permit accompanying dependent children.

eligibility_rules.fail_message: The Finnish programme requires good health, sufficient medical insurance and no criminal record.

jurisdiction.label: Embassy of Japan in Finland — Helsinki
jurisdiction.description: The Working Holiday route is for Finnish citizens resident in Finland. Current visa procedure requires email pre-check before an appointment; registered-mail application is also possible after pre-check, but the completed passport is not returned by post.
jurisdiction.ui_help: Finnish applicants must reside in Finland and use the Embassy in Helsinki.

options.label: I am a Finnish citizen resident in Finland
options.mission_label: Embassy of Japan in Finland — Helsinki
options.mission_detail: Email the documents for pre-check first. The Embassy then provides an appointment; registered-mail submission is also possible after pre-check, with in-person/proxy collection.

options.label: I am not resident in Finland
options.mission_label: Finnish Working Holiday route may not apply
options.mission_detail: The current Working Holiday conditions require Finnish citizenship and residence in Finland.
options.issue: The Finland Working Holiday route requires the applicant to be a Finnish citizen resident in Finland.

document_checklist.title: Valid Finnish passport
document_checklist.description: Passport should have at least two blank visa pages; submit the bio-data-page copy as specified.

document_checklist.title: Completed visa application form
document_checklist.description: Complete the current form; the applicant must physically sign it.

document_checklist.title: Recent 45×35mm photograph
document_checklist.description: Provide a passport-standard photo taken within the previous six months.

document_checklist.title: CV / Resume
document_checklist.description: Use the Embassy form or provide your own CV as an annex.

document_checklist.title: Reason for applying
document_checklist.description: Provide the reason for the Working Holiday application on A4 paper.

document_checklist.title: Three months of bank statements
document_checklist.description: Bank statements must be in the applicant's name and show a balance of more than €4,200.

document_checklist.title: Working Holiday pledge
document_checklist.description: Sign the current pledge with a physical signature.

preparation_checklist.title: Check the 200-visa annual cap
preparation_checklist.description: Applications close after 200 Working Holiday visas have been issued for Finnish citizens.

preparation_checklist.title: Email documents for pre-check
preparation_checklist.description: Current Embassy procedure says to pre-check the complete documents by email before appointment or registered-mail submission.

preparation_checklist.title: Apply within three months of departure
preparation_checklist.description: The Embassy does not accept applications more than three months before the scheduled departure because the issued visa is valid for three months.

preparation_checklist.title: Run a final Embassy check
preparation_checklist.description: Recheck annual-cap status and current visa procedure before lodging.
